title: Replacement System Installations — Deposit Figures, Balance Due Day and Eligible Financing Plans
content:
# Payment terms by package

The payment figures of the Replacement System Installations packages are fixed per package: the deposit percentage of the contract price, the smallest deposit taken, the day the remaining balance falls due counted from installation, and the Home Comfort Financing plans available for the package.

## Deposit and balance figures

| Package | Deposit percentage | Smallest deposit taken | Balance due (days after installation) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Harbison Essential Series System | 10 percent | $500.00 | 0 (due on the installation day) |
| Harbison Advantage Series System | 10 percent | $500.00 | 0 (due on the installation day) |
| Harbison Performance Series System | 15 percent | $500.00 | 0 (due on the installation day) |
| Harbison Performance Hybrid Heat Pump System | 15 percent | $500.00 | 0 (due on the installation day) |
| Harbison Signature Series System | 20 percent | $500.00 | 0 (due on the installation day) |
| Harbison Signature Elite Communicating System | 25 percent | $500.00 | 0 (due on the installation day) |

A balance-due figure of 0 days means the balance is due on the installation day itself.

## Home Comfort Financing plans available

| Plan | Essential Series | Advantage Series | Performance Series | Performance Hybrid Heat Pump | Signature Series | Signature Elite Communicating |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 12-Month Same-As-Cash Deferred Interest Plan | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| 18-Month 0% APR Equal Payment Plan | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| 36-Month 0% APR Equal Payment Plan | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| 60-Month 5.99% APR Fixed-Rate Plan | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| 120-Month 7.99% APR Fixed-Rate Plan | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| 144-Month 9.99% APR Fixed-Rate Plan | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

Column headings abbreviate the package names (Harbison Essential Series System through Harbison Signature Elite Communicating System, in the same order as the first table).

## Reading the figures

- The deposit percentage rises with the package: 10 percent on the two Series entry packages, 15 percent on the Harbison Performance Series System and the Harbison Performance Hybrid Heat Pump System, 20 percent on the Harbison Signature Series System and 25 percent on the Harbison Signature Elite Communicating System.
- The smallest deposit taken is $500.00 on every package.
- The 36-Month 0% APR Equal Payment Plan is available only on the Harbison Performance Hybrid Heat Pump System and the two Signature packages; the 18-Month 0% APR Equal Payment Plan on every package except the Harbison Essential Series System.
